text.jp:
……シロッコさんの話だと、幽霊馬車を待ち伏せに
行く日は<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en: From what Sirocco said, <#CTRL:0E>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
その日まで、まだ時間があるから
しっかり準備して、当日、ボクに声をかけてね。
text.official_en:
We've still got time to get everything ready!
But make sure to find me when the day comes.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
シロッコさんの話だと、幽霊馬車を
待ち伏せに行く日は今日がいいみたい。
text.official_en:
Sirocco said that today's the day we have to go and
ambush the ghost carriage.
text.real_en: According to Sirocco-san, today seems like the best day to ambush the ghost carriage.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レダさん、もう準備できた？
出発するならボクにそう言ってね。
text.official_en: Are you ready to head out? Tell me when you are.
text.real_en: Leda-san, are you ready? Tell me when it's time to leave.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
前回の試合の際に、歳近いものたちと
楽しげに語らう様子を見て――
text.official_en:
It felt bittersweet, seeing you engaging in happy
chitchat with others your age in that match.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
それがしは痛感いたしました。
やはり姫には陽の当たる場所を歩んでほしいと。
text.official_en:
I could not help but remember how badly I wanted
you to walk in the sun.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
もしもこのような事がなければ、
姫はきっと今頃は普通の娘として……
text.official_en:
If not for what happened to us, I'm sure by now you
would have grown into a happy young woman.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……復讐を果たしてからでも構いませぬ。
かならず、その日を迎えていただきたい。
text.official_en:
Even if it must be after you get your revenge, I want
to see you reach that future.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バッカニア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そのためならば、このバッカニア、
どのような努力も厭わぬ所存です。
text.official_en: I will expend every effort to help you get there.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
さて、今回の我々の計画が吉と出るか、
あるいは単に藪蛇をつついて終わるか……
text.official_en:
It's difficult to say whether our plan will be
successful or if we'll just poke the hornet's nest.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いずれにせよ、今回の事で謎の幽霊馬車および
その積荷の正体は明らかになるだろう。
text.official_en:
In either case I daresay we will uncover the truth
behind the ghost carriage and its cargo.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シロッコ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……もっとも、それはあくまで
我々が返り討ちに遭わなければ、なのだが。
text.official_en:
Though of course, that won't be of much use if they
kill us in retaliation.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
レダさんはもちろんだけど、
セオドラさんもとっても綺麗だったな……
text.official_en:
Something you and Queen Theodora have in
common is you're both reaaally pretty.
text.real_en: Leda-san was beautiful, of course, but Theodora-san was really beautiful too...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だけど、試合のあとのセオドラさん、お供の
人たちの声もほとんど聞こえてなかったような。
text.official_en:
But it was weird... After the match, it seemed like
she didn't hear what her allies were saying.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
すごく怖くて嫌だったな……
ねえ、レダさんは大丈夫だよね？
text.official_en:
That gave me the creeps. Eugh! You're going to be
OK though, right?
text.real_en: That was so frightening... Hey, Leda-san, you're going to be all right, aren't you?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ムウ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ボク……レダさんには絶対に
あんな風に、なってほしくないから……
text.official_en: I never want to see you like that.
text.real_en: I... I never want anything like that to happen to Leda-san...

text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
あたくし、神殿の今度の行事で
使用される曲の制作を依頼されましたの。
text.official_en:
I have been asked to compose a song for an
upcoming event at the temple.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ふふふ……レイリダーナ！
見ていなさいな！
text.official_en: Ohoho. Soon you shall see, Leilidahna!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
カエルスの碧き薔薇の名に恥じぬ
至上の名曲を生み出してみせますわ！
text.official_en:
I will create a masterpiece wholly worthy of my
lofty title as the Blue Rose of Caelus...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_オリンピア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そうして、この曲が流れるたびに、
あなたに敗北感を味わわせて上げますわ！
text.official_en:
and every time it rings in your ears, you will feel
the sting of defeat!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ

text.jp:
レイリダーナよ、
シラクシオは其方の役にたっておるか？
text.official_en:
Leilidahna, I hope Syracusio is making
himself useful.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あの男……有能なことには違いないのだが、
いささか策謀を巡らせすぎる嫌いがある。
text.official_en:
There's no doubt that the man is capable, but he
tends to go too far with his scheming.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……まあ、本人は良かれと思って
やっているのだろうがな。
text.official_en:
Though I'll grant that he does it with the best of
intentions.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カーラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
奴について困ったことがあったら、
すぐに妾のもとに相談にくるのだぞ。
text.official_en:
If you do have any concerns about him, come and
discuss them with me at once.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
マードル様は、１４４１年頃までは
大祭司としてこのダグシオンに居たんだ。
text.official_en:
Father Mahdel was a high priest here in Dagsion
until 1441.
text.real_en:
Mardle-sama was a high priest here in Dagsion
until 1441.

text.jp:
でも、その頃、ダグザ神殿で
ちょっとした事件が起こってね。
text.official_en:
But at a certain point, there was a bit of an incident
at Dagda's temple.

text.jp:
それが、ちょっとした醜聞で……
危うく大問題に発展しかかったんだ。
text.official_en:
It was a scandal that could have turned into a
major blowup.

text.jp:
きっかけは神官同士のつまらない
いざこざに過ぎなかったみたいなんだけど。
text.official_en:
Though seemingly, it all grew out of a minor quarrel
between priests.

text.jp:
マードル様はその責任を取る形で
大祭司の職を辞すことになったらしいよ。
text.official_en:
Father Mahdel took full responsibility for the incident
and resigned from his position.
text.real_en:
Mardle-sama took full responsibility for the incident
and resigned from his position.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
マードル様はずっと一人暮らしでね。
ご家族なんかは居なかったはずだよ。
text.official_en:
Father Mahdel always lived alone, with no one he
called family.
text.real_en:
Mardle-sama always lived alone, with no one he
called family.

text.jp:
当時住んでいた家は、もうとっくの昔に
取り壊されちゃったんじゃなかったかなあ。
text.official_en:
I hear the house he used to live in was torn down
long since.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
マードル様には当時、親友がいてね。
当時法務官だったキジェルモ様なんだけど。
text.official_en:
Father Mahdel had a best friend back in the day.
Guillermo, who was a praetor at the time.
text.real_en:
Mardle-sama had a best friend back in the day.
Quijermo-sama, who was a praetor at the time.

text.jp:
二人で、ヒラリアっていう女性の心を
射止めようと競い合う関係でもあったんだと。
text.official_en:
There's a rumor that they were competing for the
affections of a woman named Hilaria.

text.jp:
そのことがきっかけかな。二人が
大喧嘩してる場面を見かけたこともあったよ。
text.official_en:
Personally, I'm inclined to believe it. I once caught
the two of them having a fierce argument.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
キジェルモ様がシドニア郡総督に任命されて
ダグシオンから去っていった時、
text.official_en:
When Guillermo took up the role of viceroy, leaving
Dagsion to lead Cydonia...
text.real_en:
When Quijermo-sama took up the role of viceroy, leaving
Dagsion to lead Cydonia...

text.jp:
ヒラリアはキジェルモ様のほうを選んで、
そっちについて行ってしまったんだ。
text.official_en: Hilaria chose to go with him.
text.real_en: Hilaria chose Quijermo-sama and went with him.

text.jp:
そのことを、ずっと長い間、
マードル様は恨んでいたみたいだよ。
text.official_en:
Father Mahdel was stewing about that for a long,
long time afterward.
text.real_en:
Mardle-sama was stewing about that for a long,
long time afterward.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
マードル……？　そのお名前を聞くのは
随分と久しぶりだね。
text.official_en:
Mahdel? I haven't heard that name in a long time.
You mean the high priest of Dagda's temple, right?
text.real_en:
Mardle? I haven't heard that name in a long time.
You mean the high priest of Dagda's temple, right?

text.jp:
とっても立派な方さ。ダグザ神殿の大祭司で、
神威法王からの信頼も篤かったらしいよ。
text.official_en:
From all I heard he was an upstanding man—
someone highly trusted by the Divine Sovereign.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ヒラリアって人は、ずいぶん体が弱い
人だったみたいだ。
text.official_en: It's said Hilaria had a frail constitution.

text.jp:
マードル様は人間の寿命を延ばす研究を
していたっていう噂もあるけど。
text.official_en:
If you believe the rumors, Father Mahdel was
tirelessly researching ways to extend the lifespan...
text.real_en:
If you believe the rumors, Mardle-sama was
tirelessly researching ways to extend the lifespan...

text.jp:
もしかしたら、それは他ならぬ、
ヒラリアの為だったのかもしれないね。
text.official_en: Maybe he was doing it for her.
